notes.content:
[previewyoutube=xAxe3zIY4SE;full][/previewyoutube]

Hello everyone! ːogupartyː

We've implemented an action update that enhances speed and improves the synergy between skills, reflecting the feedback you've shared through reviews and on Discord.

Check out the details below!


Controls

Dash  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/adbc07916ce091c7a93d00e56ceb54430ad6a4c1.gif  
After swinging the ladle, press the roll button while moving in the direction you're facing to dash forward.

Backstep  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/df5382fd7fdec4ea80422828ce848a1b2d5c6c9f.gif  
After swinging the ladle, press the roll button without holding the movement key to quickly backstep and evade.

Roll -> Ladle Swing  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/d57e0ca31ecd6b1b7041a272cae8ec2dd1132459.gif  
You can chain a ladle swing while rolling.

Rolling System Update  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/398bc528acea929b8b863f92ea5844c5bdab6280.gif  
The cooldown for rolling has been removed. Additionally, after swinging the ladle, you can now roll in a direction other than where you're facing.

Headbutt Shield  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/c97511436ab81d4fb8e21f60368f637ccf4e883e.gif  
You gain invincibility for the first 1 second while charging a headbutt.

Headbutt Backstep  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/5d2bbcfc1fc9075d0f10ded0c1ad3d3739c23d96.gif  
While charging a headbutt, press the roll button to backstep.

Critical Hit System Update  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/39f28f3f56b025d7340ef787af449183a85f6af8.gif  
You can trigger critical hits more frequently by performing various actions.

Dancing in Excitement  
The time it takes to start dancing when in an excited state has been reduced.

Invincibility Time After Being Hit  
The invincibility time after being hit has been increased from 0.5 seconds to 1 second. Additionally, enemies no longer gain invincibility after being hit.

Trading Cards & Point Shop  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/f02791f5726430b8ba771dda82d66fc78d363f34.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/2c1db2533816218d2f0642c42c0774361526b573.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/e555f70a0cb0ed40123d0dcf1a91583c8596de17.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/42489f9e776a99f92214234296d00068ef978b63.png

Steam trading cards and point shop items have been added. Customize your profile with Ogu and the Secret Forest-themed items!

The Ogu and the Secret Forest Points Shop can be accessed by clicking on the 'Points Shop' tab in the Library, on the Steam launcher.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/6bafb9ea7736223d64fb77280f5a3922e51a63ea.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/a9e597a33e4bd1cefe92bbe08eacf9fb80fdae0a.png


System
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/fafa4a0e0351f29a8cb9a211672be831280b3e3e.gif  

 Fixed an issue where Baby Ogu would get stuck on the edge of obstacles.
 Adjusted the colliders of some boss monsters.


Graphics

  
 Improved the swinging motion of Baby Ogu's ladle.  
 Enhanced hit effects.  
 Improved the effects when enemies take damage.  


Content

  
 Some totems’ abilities have been adjusted due to control changes.  
 After clearing Esmeralda's museum quest, the location of the antique shop is now marked on the map.  


System
You can now toggle the controller quick menu on/off in the options.

Bugs
Fixed an issue where enemies hit by Baby Ogu's swing would be pulled towards Baby Ogu while facing backward.




We hope this update enhances your experience in *Ogu and the Secret Forest* with more thrilling and enjoyable gameplay.

Thank you! ːogudanceː

notes.title: [Update] v1.1 - Random Encounters & QOL
notes.content:
Hello! ːsteamhappyː

We’re excited to introduce the update notes for version 1.1, which includes various new content and quality-of-life improvements.

[previewyoutube=VAuComRGSso;full][/previewyoutube]


Cutscenes Added

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/feb63fc987a5b2ba4748a6ff7a7e146267a911f3.gif

A total of 9 area entrances and key in-game moment cutscenes have been added.
We plan to add a feature that will allow players to rewatch the in-game cutscenes in the future.


Divine Beast Rooms

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/07a2337be1d6e9ead35104ec9c327707bfc562e4.gif

We've added 'Divine Beast Rooms', random encounters that help players collect jewelss, top-tier fish, regional insects, and various cores. You can find 'Divine Beast Rooms' across the world, and by offering items at the shrines, different interactions become available based on the item type.



 Offer common minerals or jewels to access a room with every type of gem.
 You can acquire 1 jewel but if you spend 1 jewel to the shrine, you can acquire 2 jewels.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/07643e8853b1582d8eada52900ba46d7252cb79e.png



 Offer bait or fish to access a room where all top-tier fish appear.
 You can catch 1 fish, or 2 fish if you spend a top-tier fish to the shrine.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/4d43c377060cb675599dc072a7e08196c0b91ac7.png



 Access a room where all types of regional insects appear.
 You can catch 1 insect, or 2 insects if you offer a region-exclusive insect.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/156f9dc6216e7f23365f323ce7a1ff6a91f4ddbe.png

Other Encounters

 Offering cooking ingredients(except fishes), upgrade materials, or cores will summon a monster that drops Filthy or Fallen Cores with a 100% success rate.
 Normally, 1 monster will be summoned, but offering a Filthy or Fallen Core will summon 2 monsters. 

In the Divine Beast Rooms, you'll encounter rare collectibles in one place, but obtaining the desired item will require some skill.

Additionally, the more you explore, the higher the chance of encountering a Divine Beast Room.


Newspapers

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/ad42d5bacc00ad08bd25e179bf997bac7a5e355b.png

You can now buy newspapers from the consumable merchants in each village.
Using a newspaper provides information about items exclusive to that region.

* If you already know all the information, nothing will happen!


Shell Game

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/122d0b5a976ab0e070b7fcd6fa22c1d4cf59417a.gif

A new mini-game called 'Shell Game' has been added as a random encounter, where you can obtain dish for your adventure journal. By paying a small fee, you can collect dish and fill up your journal.

If you’ve already completed the food section of the journal, you will receive a All-in-One Cooking Kit as a reward.



Cooking Restoration Device

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/2a07e7b28f9630b3d1fa284dc66f40c9a4138489.gif

A random encounter has been added that allows you to turn failed items('Food' or 'Food Waste') into random dishes. This encounter can be used 3 times when found.



Improved Menu Accessibility (Controller)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/5a3aad61cb82765cec6e29578794aa08f476257d.gif

We’ve added interactions to allow controller users to more easily navigate through menus and the adventure journal


Puzzle Hint Addition & Accessibility Improvements

Hints have been added to certain puzzles, and for those that require observation of small objects, we've added areas that zoom in on the screen to improve visibility.


Even after this update, additional updates are planned to make the gameplay experience more convenient and enriching. Please look forward to it!

notes.title: [Dev Log] Summer Sale & Official Release
notes.content:
Hello! ːsteamhappyː

We are working hard for the official release on July 29th.

Currently, "Ogu and the Secret Forest" is on a 15% discount during the Steam Summer Sale, which will be the last discount before the official release. If you haven't purchased "Ogu and the Secret Forest" yet, consider doing so now!

The major issues we're working on are the final battle and ending, which are still under wraps, and improving the convenience of existing content.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/80456a45fdbaf4e8416306d91439d05f6d6bb843.png

To avoid spoilers about the final battle, here are some improvements you'll see in the official release:


1. Display of Fish Species at Fishing Spots

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/eeef5da0a7ff8792a360b6ef81bc1afe28e89b16.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/2ebf570b6402a031f35af7d383a95a1b70c021ec.gif

New signs will be placed at each fishing spot, showing the types of fish that appear there. Fish you have caught before will be highlighted.


2. Cooking System Changes

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/d0b114bd4b90fb8e6a07e825e408641a99b8a09b.gif

The cooking system has been improved as follows:

When There is No Recipe
Selecting ingredients not in a recipe will now not proceed with cooking and will display a message indicating that there is no related recipe.

Cooking Gauge and Extra Rewards
A gauge showing the progress of the cooking process has been added.

 If the gauge is very low at the end of cooking, food waste is created.
 If the gauge is low, food is created.
 If the gauge is normal or above, a dish is created.
 If the gauge is very high, 2 dishes are created.



3. Sold Out

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/cb8c8bc58f563a2ae7a27bb13ddd77b99593e1cd.gif

When all items are purchased from shops that sell limited items like equipment and interior goods, the shop shutters will close.


4. Sun Village Telescope

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/37c137350a126b8a00f042688f6cd39fd1afda13.gif

Looking through the telescope at the Sun Village observatory, you can now see the scenery that was previously displayed as text.


5. Baby Ogu Dance

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/baf435d760d57cb8dbd25f5e18700b1a2a95799b.gif

If you don't control Baby Ogu for a certain period, he will dance in place.



We will continue to provide updates on development and release news until the official launch.

Please look forward to the official release on July 29th!

notes.title: [Dev Log] Additional Content 2-1
notes.content:
Hello!

I'm excited to share the development status of the final additional content that will be updated at the end of this month. This update includes all the remaining unreleased areas and content except for the final battle.

Road of Proof

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/4c67f4b248311bbde7b549eefd6f054129606225.png

The map related to the "Sigil of the Tree', which was previously inaccessible in the main quest, will be revealed.

The 'Road of Proof', accessible from the south of the Central Forest, is where the teachers who taught baby Ogu gather. This path leads to the final battle location, so the teachers will check if baby Ogu is ready to face the final boss.

Central Cave

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/108e7f07b79782981ef95ea3f047288300fe29c9.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/53a3365fef839e7284eeb59050d317bba370fc72.png

In the Central Cave, you will be able to mine two types of gems that were previously unobtainable and encounter trash monsters and puzzles related to the overall story of the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/542f6466e216cc0e73336e2103f231c80f21d7d9.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/d3fe4e2ae197f84a285f7727e193c2db976a4a23.png

Apple Woods and Related Area Updates

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/732fa285285179bff2972909ed35fc7aa9683552.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/371492cd349224d02d5f77f32d563f6394487734.png

The quests and related areas of the Apple Woods, leading from the southwestern world to Hermit Crab Village, will be revealed. Small quests involving 'Panpan', who runs the orchard, as well as the mountain path connected to the Apple Forest and Bee Village, will be updated.

Harbor Town Quest

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/e12bf2862b53ea5d9d559c911915592406c0f5c5.png

A small quest will be added to Harbor Town.

Others

The northern area of Sky Island and the ruins of the Moon Forest Cave will become accessible. Additionally, about 20 new Piece of Artifact will be added to complete all museum collections.

Schedule

This update is scheduled for the end of April. Following this, development of the final boss fight and final testing will proceed, with an official release planned for the end of July.

Thank you to everyone who has supported us, and we will do our best to ensure a successful official launch.

Thank you!

notes.title: [Dev Log] Additional Content and advanced systems
notes.content:
Hello! 😊

Before we prepare for the final journey to the Sigil of the Tree content, we're currently wrapping up the blocked-off sections and hidden content in the areas released so far.

Accordingly, the next update will include many maps and various mid-bosses, along with mini-games and puzzles, even though it is not a new area update.

Please check out the key contents below!


Trial of the Waterfall
As some of you may know, there is a hidden space behind a waterfall somewhere in the Village of the Sun.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/a90db3ea8f83b78e45c6e8a1e824348d8264ed2d.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/c2242246aec9b0e8ed421439454de48704078009.png

Fittingly named 'Trial of the Waterfall,' behind this waterfall lies a challenging puzzle involving 'pushing' mechanics and a hidden boss that you would never have imagined.


Temple of Dance

Somewhere in the eastern jungle is a hidden temple dedicated to the study of the monkey's dance.
What could possibly happen in this scary yet exciting place?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/490e30f7ff004faaf30d5dca5c5e34c4fde00704.png


Dusky Town and the Tennis Match
The path at the entrance of the Moon Forest Village that many of you have been curious about is set to open.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/5ec320545281c01746cad0b7e4c5bd88b238844a.png

Taking advantage of the chaos caused by the corrupted Silk Worm Warrior, a bug named 'Blanc' wearing white shorts is ruling over the Dusky Town.
What will happen in Dusky Town, where tennis is loved?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/55b4fdaaeaa80edef066b12b92a79d7bb15dc521.png

Anglerfish Cave and Temple of Cuisine
You'll be able to play the hidden temple and Anglerfish Cave in the latter part of the sea area.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/d32c0c05c2a1ce97046e56d93e1a9ec011fb1e2b.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/9ccf5ff93114608c2f300220aa2ee17dcfc2f224.png

In the temple, you can acquire a new sea area hat, and in the cave, you'll meet a new mid-boss.

Penguin Island

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/3c9db9165fae8bff7a970fa0d00e5100e7a9ddc1.png

Solve the creepy mystery hidden among the adorable penguins!

Tucker's House

On the western path of the Central Forest, there is a secluded cabin.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/8f4541bdd2755d93b1778a006346ea26ac81027d.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/1df46b060977474f7de533030c60228610434c21.png

If the boss battle is tricky, return to the village to heal and buy items that will help in combat before challenging again!

Additional Features for Hats

Various functions are planned to be added to the hats that have not had specific features so far.
Stay tuned!

Value Adjustment for Mini-Games and Items

The rewards for mini-games, which were low compared to playtime and difficulty, are set to increase.
With the adjustments in the value of in-game content, the values of items will also be revised.




The update is scheduled for the third week of March.
We hope many of you will enjoy 'Ogu and the Secret Forest' even more with the preparations we've made.

Thank you!

Hello! ːsteamhappyː

We are currently working on the development of our next content update while exploring various ways to improve the convenience features within the game. Today, we would like to introduce some of the major buildings in the upcoming 'Harbor Town' area.

Harbor Town Entrance

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/f216e43dcf83b812e941332e0684b9145e3cf300.gif

If you follow the central forest southward, you will find a path leading to the Harbor Town entrance. Unlike the bustling Harbor Town where many people live, the atmosphere at the entrance is relatively calm.

SoongSoong Express Headquarters

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/161c34bceac18c3c7829c24bfbce3891c64643c2.png

Next to the bridge leading to the Harbor Town is the SoongSoong Express headquarters building. Unlike the Sun Village monkeys who live traditionally, following the "capitalistic nature" the employees of SoongSoong Express provide balloon transport services from all over the world to improve their reputation.

Who works at SoongSoong Express headquarters and what kind of interesting things can be found there?

Harbor Town

The Harbor Town is a major city located in the southern part of the world. Various NPCs gather here and carry out economic activities in places such as a museum, restaurant, antique shop, and workshop.

Museum and Fountain

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/c2996ae1ea856eafa913011444c81518d0da64fc.png

The museum was built to inform the world about everything when a hero appeared to save it someday. Located in the center of the Harbor Town and accessible via a tunnel beneath the hero's basement, the museum is unknown to the villagers because the museum director, Gogo, has left it unattended for a long time.

In addition, there is a fountain, a famous landmark of Harbor Town, located in front of the museum. It is said that if you throw a coin into the fountain and make a wish, something good will happen.

Gordon and Olive's Restaurant

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/876fc420617eda9e13e74d19ffef22b23557554b.png

The reason why Harbor Town's commerce is so active is because of the ships that enable trade with other continents. Although the crew has already been through many battles, there may be a place where Baby Ogu's help is needed.

The content we introduced today is only a small part of the Harbor Town, and new characters and quest lines, as well as systems that interact with existing areas, are being prepared.

notes.title: Q&A Answers!
notes.content:
Hello!ːsteamhappyː
We’ve assembled questions that you guys asked last week!


Q. How long is the playtime of the game?

In this current build, we have three main regions to play and the playtime will be around 5 hours to clear.

Single region contains about 1.5 hours of playtime, thus all six regions after the full release will have an estimate of 10 hours of game playtime.

However, this is only if you play the main storyline and not the additional contents such as sub quests, housing and collecting various collectibles. That’s going to take a lot longer than the main storyline.


Q. What’s the cost of the game?

The early access of the ‘Ogu and the Secret Forest’ will be 17.99 USD. The cost will increase when the game is fully released.


Q.Will there be any hidden hats ... ?!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/7e9252ae02d5ddbe7785ca4de2a3c21b755c6989.png

Yeah! There are many hidden hats throughout the game. Some are sold in shops however, some may only be acquirable through secret discovery. There will be more hats to come!

Q. What is the origin of ‘Baby Ogu’? Is Ogu from the stars?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/f3c65c45410f5fcad33eebf21cf287042feb447e.png


Q. Is multiplayer going to be featured in the game?

‘Ogu and the Secret Forest’ is a single player adventure game.
Multiplayer is not available in the game.

Q. How old is ‘Baby Ogu’? lol

59000 years old.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/9cbd8ea4d3f7c2725ef02cce0ea0b380f74ec22a.png



Q. Can we hear the characters' voices?

Our main character ‘Baby Ogu’ is a silent protagonist. We wanted the players to imagine what the characters might sound like.

Also creating more than 100 unique characters’ voices might cause some difficulties to the creation process. This is why we decided not to include voices for the characters.

Q. Will there be more language supports?

Currently, ‘Ogu and the Secret Forest’ is supporting Korean, English, Japanese, Chinese (Traditional and Simplified). During the 1 year period of early access, we’ll try our best to include language support for more countries.

Q. What do you want the players to feel playing this game?

We want the players to feel nostalgic. The feeling of the joy and pure curiosity we felt when we played video games when we were younger. But most of all, we want everyone to enjoy it!

notes.title: [Dev Journal 4] Conceptualizing and Planning of the Desert Region
notes.content:
[Dev Journal 3] Conceptualizing and Planning of the Desert Region

Early look at how we created the Desert region.

Hello! ːsteamhappyː

Today, we’ll have a look at the conceptualization and the art of the dangerous and barren Desert area.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/899dd3703be4221539c2b4a8ae0022886f965f7c.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/fab4f3d471cf6e17ec52bc069b32f604031fa462.gif


Atmosphere

Unlike the Jungle and the Moon Forest, the Desert area has much less puzzle element but has it’s main focus towards combat and pathfinding scenarios.

To represent its barren theme, the object design is much bigger than our main protagonist Baby Ogu.

Also unlike the other regions where the main route is guided with roads, the Desert region is big and has no road for guidance.

▼Concept Art

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/0bf7085546140d22bdc25bd644d004c389e90b47.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/d738a29c4bd908038b82e38e4a4bfcf53120cdb7.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/e2303d9543e2d12231269af33b069fe058d51053.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/dbd50434008035ac14320b35558bc0884e8242fe.png


▼In-Game Representation


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/365a84f8a37ceb3ad581db676a707acc14d67a32.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/201466f469cb7dbbe1d7fd52b236fe81da5ab8c5.png



Caves

The Desert region is the homeland for the intelligent ancient Shrews.
However, one day when the piece of the God fell to the ground, it corrupted the native organisms. This caused the feral animals and the cacti monsters to emerge and became a threat to the native Shrews.

The Shrews then had to escape underground so that they could hide from the Cactus monsters that were keen to devour them.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/dd640b03a3a6eb8c7a994ccd6c34bb5e2c806fe3.png


* These scenes are blurred to avoid spoilers.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/f21ea248efc9b35615512e877dd7a6a844181a3e.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/2e5212b96c9c898de5dd91539ef9731f77b3aa75.png

You, the player, need to utilise your sense of direction with the help of the ancient Shrew technology to find your way to your destination.

Mecha Shrew DDAT-G 5000

To design the Desert region as a more dynamic and interesting blood-boiling area, we wanted to include something that is unique to this region.

This is why we included the giant monsters that are dozens of times bigger than our Baby Ogu. To combat this, we introduced the ‘Mecha Shrew DDAT-G 5000’

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/0fd19a94bc54fad0c01758bccdc26296501b7dcf.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/16f4f2bf9bdde5331d1aaebffe1aed0487e75d00.gif

The ‘Mecha Shrew DDAT-G 5000’ is under construction within the ‘Shrew Village’ underground. To finish it’s construction they need the help of our hero Baby Ogu.

They say they need some key materials to finish its construction and Baby Ogu can help them find these materials through fighting the cactus monsters above the ground.



Play the game to find out more about what’s going on in the Desert region!
Thank you!

notes.title: [Dev Journal 3] Conceptualizing and Planning of the Moon Forest Region
notes.content:
Hello! ːsteamhappyː

Today, we’ll have a look at the early concept art at the dark, mysterious and beautiful ‘Moon Forest’

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/9051fb9464bf07496a42e4f3e74ea73d90c3637f.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/04fe4d50c013503b74b09b5cd92b58730a6843bb.gif

[previewyoutube=ezepGchpIJQ;full][/previewyoutube]


The ‘Moon Forest’ is located in the northern area of the world. There are various puzzles in this region and you can also collect a variety of ores using the smelter.


Strange Vegetations

Unlike the ‘Jungle’ region where the ever shining Sun is its main motif, The ‘Moon Forest’ has a main motif of the subtle glow of the Moon.
This led us to create a dark and calm atmosphere throughout this region. This is why the vegetation in this area has a colorfully glowing nature.

Concept Art
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/548ab5165da18f3d694cac1eb9e327cdcf783725.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/72e0866ccc77db55cc7a4866350bbaa8bfbbaf8a.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/56d48eb56348c141da349a3bc9e9264fbaf591fb.gif




Ethnic Traditions

The ‘Moon Forest’ is home to a variety of bug villagers. We did not want the bug people to live in naturalistic simple architecture. We wanted it to represent some culture they might have.

This is the reason why we chose to have the traditional building architecture of Korea. We hoped that this would give the bug people some backstory of their culture. These styles of buildings are rarely found in adventure games and we hoped that it would be a unique feature of our world.

notes.title: [Dev Journal 2] Conceptualizing and Planning of the Jungle Region
notes.content:
Hello! ːsteamhappyː

  Today we’ll introduce you to the starting area of the game. This is how we started the creation of the ‘Jungle Region’.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/606c0915a6461b52c577c18d9634cca54c99f2e6.png

[previewyoutube=2BLmJIEzz_o;full][/previewyoutube]


  The north east area of the world is the Jungle region. This area is divided in two which includes the Starting Area, where you start your journey, and the Jungle Outskirt where the story builds up.


  Since this is where we make the first impression of the game, we wanted to create an area where it is full of visual interests along with some fairly simple puzzles and combat scenarios that will introduce the players to the gameplay.

Waterfall of the Meditating Monkey
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/b6b5be24b53b3bf97a4a1247101e78880f1b123a.gif

The Village of the Sun’s residents, the monkeys, have a deep respect towards nature and are living in harmony with it. Also they always train their minds for peace and clarity by meditation.
You can occasionally encounter these meditating monkeys at the Waterfall in front of the village.

Temple of the Sun

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/adc31d16927f20915a511d72d9fde83002ad352f.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/ef6c3f166522cf0055a7cdffecdfa4f037573d56.png

  At the ‘Temple of the Sun’ lies the ‘Sigil of the Sun’. One of the 6 broken pieces of the world.
  The monkeys are waiting for the chosen one from their folklore to arrive and bring harmony back to the world. They have found one of the broken pieces and are keeping it safe for the rightful hero’s arrival.

To visually represent these thematic concepts, we’ve tried to incorporate the architectural style of the ancient magnificent and mysterious ‘Angkor Wat’ as a reference.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/7a6ddf7285a38cdd15e9db8223bf65820e9d986e.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/fa2286bcfaa74a6a9794d5bfa6e633f32bb7253c.png

  ‘The Temple of the Sun’ is the first dungeon that the player will come across. We’ve tried to represent the classic adventure-game style dungeon that we all love. It also introduces to the players the hints of core mechanics of puzzles and combat. We designed the dungeon so that it represents few of the core gameplay mechanics.

  Before, the dungeon only contained puzzles until you encountered the boss. However, we thought that this wasn’t enough of a representation of our game play. This is why we redesigned the dungeon so that it has more combat scenarios including the ‘Monkey Sentinel’ fight.

Village of the Sun

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/d38ad6bb8de55ec1e0552fdc3e250f734ad5a8ba.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/37f032a5e29fc0705a7b503f93645b51c34bfc48.gif

  ‘Village of the Sun’ is the first town that you’ll come across adventuring in the vast world of  secret forest. This is the biggest map so far out of approximately 200 maps that exist in the game right now. There are various NPCs including Merchants, Quests and information givers, Fishing tutorial guy and also people that just wanna have a little chat with our protagonist ‘Baby Ogu’. There is also another important aspect to this town. The ‘Hero’s House’.

Hero’s House

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/9d47a69da43faafc5db8792476ddc16deb8dafbd.png

  Early design of the ‘Hero’s House’ was a simple area where you can visit throughout the adventure to replenish various expendables and maybe harvest some crops and upgrade some gears. However, since we created more interactable objects including hotspring, upgrade station, cooking campfire and chairs just to name a few, we wanted the ‘Hero’s House’ to be able to be customized to the player’s liking. This is why we implemented the housing system.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/35dbf8eae9cb8d4b0653d0f73a667395036fedc4.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/37c514166c84ec594f5e0ecb46d720716decf5f7.gif

  Housing system was developed and implemented during the 3rd closed beta test and still is under construction to be refined. We’re currently developing more furniture and objects so that you can have a unique home. Until early access, we’ll implement as much as we can.

Next, we’ll talk about the ‘Moon Forest’.
See you soon!

notes.title: [Dev Journal 1] Early Plans and Concept Arts
notes.content:
Hello! ːsteamhappyː

  First of all, we welcome with a warm heart to all the people waiting for the game and all of you that came through the steam nextfest! This is ‘Ogu and the Secret Forest’.

  We’re currently working on the build for launching the early access in March. We can’t share many details yet. So instead, for the people that are wondering how ‘Ogu and the Secret Forest’ came about, we wanted to share some thought processes that’s been considered before all this journey started. A little glimpse at the mind of developers if you will. Hope you like it!

The World Building and the Structure of the Game

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/5f9563ab375adfee2780c5d144d8c531d697793a.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/7b2d2ec83b96dffe8cc46b3c2b80f42ea263dc87.png


  ‘Ogu and the Secret Forest’ has always had a main theme of an adventure of a child who is very curious and pure.

  ‘Baby Ogu’ the main protagonist who is a ‘selfless curious platypus venturing into a new unknown world guided by a mysterious powerful being’ was our starting point. To create a story around this theme, we drew a lot of motifs from the famous ‘Alice in wonderland’, Studio Ghibli's ‘Spirited away’ and ‘My neighbour Totoro’.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/4a29939f403a4b3209e484eebe639fa676e3c2de.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/9e4fdbb70a2544cbdb7955b1cdc35bfeb7f3a229.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/6e8a5f600640598535cdb602afd71db0879313fb.png



  We didn’t want the path to be linear so that the player may choose their own way of progression. This is why we decided to create a world with several differently themed regions and let the players choose which region they may want to visit. It is because of this reason we’ve decided to create the ‘Go find the Sigils’ system.

  Due to the lack of development manpower with only 4 people in the whole project, of course creating something that is completely nonlinear is without a doubt a great challenge.
However, until the complete official release we’ll try our best to create something that is as unique of an experience as it can be for every other player. That is our goal.


Character Concept

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/bc396b5d9deba5b7ce2d000fc0e229f9657dcfc0.png


  Every character design and animation has been hand drawn by the original artist ‘Jong-Beom Moon’ of the ‘Moonlab Studio’. Since the artist has a liking towards animals and bugs, you may find the unique yet somewhat familiar style of the artwork quite charming.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/1dd50e62dacc914f8fd24a499eb76e6e7e0c5ee8.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/9b8dcb70395abd52388d917f51903fe7cabb4ae8.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/68ccc91803ff199a2ea1c60d004e8ad6668ade83.png


  In the current demo version you can meet our hero ‘Baby Ogu’ and the monkeys of the ‘Village of the Sun’. However, We assure you there are a variety of animal friends such as birds, shrews, insects, hippo and many more that are eager to meet you as well!

  That’s it for now! We’ll tell you more about our journey with the creation process of ‘Jungle region’, ‘Moon Forest’, ‘Desert region’ and so on. Thank you and see you again!

Puzzles

This status will be acquirable through visiting a town or consuming certain food.

Keyboard, Controller, Mobile controls has been changed accordingly.

When Baby Ogu is running, the camera will now pan to a wider view.

The visual special effects has been added when Baby Ogu's health is low or if there are negative status effects.
